meta_description: Your company's chain: its structure, rights, decisions, resources and agents.
structure_empty: No unit at this date. Start with a unit type, then the top unit.
field_key_hint: Lowercase, no space: branch, legal_entity, team.
error_forbidden: Only owners and admins change the structure.
error_cycle: A unit cannot go under itself or one of its own units.
error_closed: This is closed at that date.
error_primary_overlap: This person already has a primary assignment over that period.
error_ends_before_start: The end cannot come before the start.
error_not_found: This does not exist in your organization.
error_invalid_input: Check the fields: a value does not fit.
error_generic: That did not go through. Try again in a moment.
rights_none: No particular right: you see the units where you hold a position.
rights_holder: To a position or a person
error_duplicate: This already exists under that name.
field_address_hint: In https: its identity card is read there (/.well-known/kete).
error_own_request: A person does not decide her own request.
error_already_pending: A promotion request is already waiting for this resource.
circuits_none: No circuit: each feature keeps its own review.
circuit_threshold_hint: Empty: always. For a resource: 1 low risk, 2 medium or unknown, 3 high.
error_unknown_subject: This kind of request does not exist.
error_in_circuit: This promotion is decided in its circuit, from the Inbox.
gateway_explain: Add this MCP address to Claude, ChatGPT or any copilot: it will see what you see, and act for you, never beyond your rights.
gateway_how: In Claude: Settings, Connectors, Add a custom connector, then paste the address. It will ask you to sign in.
agents_none: No agent works for you yet.
compliance_forbidden: Compliance is read with the « See compliance » permission over the whole organization.
frameworks_none: No framework: start with the one that has a real deadline.
requirement_summary_hint: In your own words: a standard's text is never copied.
check_registry_apps_have_card: Every app has its card and its owner
check_agents_act_for_someone: Every position's agent has someone to act for
document_write: Write a document or a new version
error_unknown_check: This automatic check does not exist.
error_not_automatic: This control is attested by a person.
error_own_writing: A version is approved by someone other than its author.
error_not_owner: Only the person it is assigned to says an action is done.
error_not_done: The action is not done yet.
error_own_action: Effectiveness is verified by someone else.
demo_viewing: You are viewing {name}'s space, with their rights.
admin_explain: The organization's frame: who is who, who may do what, which tools are on. The tools' content belongs to the business owners, in their space.
admin_rights: Roles and grants, by position and scope
admin_circuits: Who approves what, described as data
admin_registry: Apps, MCP servers, skills and agents, with their tier and risk
admin_agents: {active} active agent(s), each serving a person
admin_ai_none: No model set: briefings follow rules
modules_explain: Each business tool is switched on for the whole organization. Switched off, it leaves the spaces; its data stays.
module_surveys: Questionnaires, campaigns sent by link, answers and results: staff, customer and intern satisfaction, evaluations.
module_performance: Indicators with six attributes, grids per position, objectives, protocols and the quarterly review up to performance factors.
module_meetings: Meetings, agendas drawn from the gaps, decision records, decision notes and the action register.
module_compliance: Frameworks, controls, evidence, audits, findings and corrective actions.
module_agents: Permanent agents with a job description, who watch and report.
people_import_explain: Paste one line per person, from a spreadsheet: name ; e-mail ; phone ; position title. Each person gets the position as primary, from today. Someone who signs in with that e-mail finds herself on her own.
people_counts: {people} people, {linked} with an account. The others receive their personal links by e-mail.
circuits_forbidden: Circuits are managed with the « decisions: manage » permission.
outbox_capture: Test mode: no e-mail leaves. Each one stays here, and its links work as for its recipient.
outbox_send: Send mode: e-mails leave through the provider and do not stay here.
demo_explain: This organization is a demo: its people and their e-mails are fictitious. Open someone's space to see and act with their rights, never more.
demo_by_link_explain: These people have no account: they receive their links by e-mail. Open the test outbox to follow them.
link_invalid_title: This link is no longer valid
link_invalid: It may have expired, or a new link was sent to you. Ask the person who sent it.
error_module_disabled: This tool is not on in your organization.
error_view_as_forbidden: Only an administrator of a demo organization may view another person's space.
error_link_invalid: This link is no longer valid.
about_none: The organization (or the units of the sections)
audience_outside_list: One line per person: name ; e-mail
campaign_min_group_hint: Below it, an anonymous campaign shows no score for the group.
campaign_opened: {respondents} people surveyed: {sent} links sent, {relayed} to pass on by hand (sent to you).
campaign_remind_action: Remind those who have not answered
campaign_reminded: {count} reminders sent, with a new link.
campaign_closed_done: Campaign closed: its links no longer open.
campaign_published_done: Results published: they feed the indicators.
questionnaire_anonymous: Anonymous: once sent, answers are no longer tied to their author
questionnaire_used: used: copy it to change it
respondent_no_email: no e-mail: link passed on by hand
results_explain: {forms} forms received. Score on 100: (average − 1) ÷ 4 × 100, « not applicable » left out. A group of fewer than {min} answers shows no score.
survey_intro: {name}, here are your forms for {period}, to send before {closes}.
survey_anonymous: Your answers are anonymous: once sent, they are no longer tied to your name.
survey_scale: 1 = not satisfied at all · 5 = very satisfied
survey_sent: Thank you, your form is sent.
survey_incomplete: Some required questions are still unanswered.
surveys_explain: Campaigns sent by personal link, their follow-up and results; then the questionnaires they use.
error_used: A campaign already used this questionnaire: copy it to change it.
factor_fallback: Review not held: factor set to the average of the last two quarters, and the failure reported to HR.
performance_explain: The quarters and their reviews, then the job profiles: each grid with its six attributes. A colour obliges to act; missing data counts as red, charged to the management.
performance_profiles_explain: Imported from the indicators referential. A position takes the profile that carries its title.
quarter_open_action: Open: freeze and notify the grids
quarter_opened: {reviews} reviews opened: {sent} grids notified by e-mail, {relayed} to pass on by hand.
quarter_measures_closed: Measures closed: {missing} lines without a value turn red.
quarter_closed_done: Quarter closed: {missed} reviews not held get the average of their last two quarters.
record_protocols_hint: The manager's note, based on dated deviations. Outside variable pay.
record_not_signed_manager: Not yet signed by the manager
record_not_signed_person: Not yet signed by the person
record_waiting: The record is written once the measures are closed.
review_link_intro: {name}, position « {position} ». Your indicators do not change during the quarter.
review_acknowledge_explain: Your indicators are notified in writing before they apply. Confirm you have read them.
team_explain: The reviews of the people who report to you: write and sign their record once the measures are closed.
validate_explain: Consistency across directions: the same performance must earn the same appraisal. Validation freezes the factors.
error_not_reviewer: Only the person's manager writes and signs first.
error_wrong_step: This is not the step for that gesture.
decision_owner: {name}, by {due} — in the register of actions
decision_idea: idea kept in the innovation register
meeting_planned_done: Meeting planned: {items} items drawn from the gaps.
meeting_record_waiting: The record is published once the meeting is held.
meetings_explain: Meetings start from the gaps — indicators in red, overdue actions — and end with dated actions. Decision notes take the year's next number.
assistant_explain: Your assistant acts for you, with your rights and never more: it sees what you see, prepares and explains, and never decides for you. It has no pay data.
assistant_unavailable: The assistant is not configured for your organization yet.
assistant_thinking: The assistant is reading your registers…
resources_explain: The apps, skills, MCP servers and agents your space, your team and the organization open to you, with their owner. To add one, register it.
ai_no_model: No model is configured: the briefing is written by rules, the assistant is unavailable.
ai_model_explain: The model is chosen in the instance's environment, never from a screen; its key shows nowhere.
ai_budget_explain: Past it, no call is made until next month: the briefing falls back to rules.
structure_explain: Units, positions and their holders at a date: the chart, the tree or the table.
my_agents_explain: The agents acting for you: their mission, scope, level and signals. An agent never holds more rights than you.
resources_none: No resource of this kind at this tier.
actions_explain: What meetings decided, what indicators call for, what audits ask: one owner, one deadline.
error_budget_spent: The organization's monthly AI budget is spent: an administrator can raise it.
error_model_failed: The model did not answer. Try again in a moment.
error_signed_out: Your session expired: sign in again.
assistant_suggestion_day: What should I do first today?
assistant_suggestion_readings: Which app readings can I take into the reviews?
assistant_suggestion_team: Where does my team stand this quarter?
assistant_placeholder: Ask; the assistant prepares; you decide.
assistant_hint: {model} · the assistant acts with your rights and prepares drafts you validate.
assistant_hint_rules: The assistant acts with your rights and prepares drafts you validate.
draft_title_measure: Measure of a review line · draft
inbox_drafts_explain: Your agents prepare; nothing exists until you validate.
apr_explain: Ask for the app your team needs: IT decides, then the factory creates it, connects it to the system and codes a first version you review.
apr_new_explain: Describe the need in plain words. IT uses it to decide, the factory and the coding agent to build.
apr_section_need_body: What the app must do, and for whom.
apr_section_data_body: What the app handles, and what an outage costs: IT deduces the controls from it.
apr_slug_hint: Lowercase, digits and dashes: it names the kete-… repository
apr_purpose_hint: At least 20 characters: the tasks, the screens, the rules.
apr_approve_body: The factory creates the repository, the database, the Compte Kete sign-in and the hosting, then an agent codes a first version.
apr_reason: Reason, for the person who asked
apr_factory_off: The factory is not configured: an approved request waits.
criticality_high: Work stops, or money is lost
criticality_critical: Safety, legal obligations or every customer
error_factory_unreachable: The factory does not answer: send again later.
rights_no_app_permissions: No app in the registry declares its permissions yet.
rights_apps_explain: An app's permissions come from its identity card. As soon as a role carries one, these rights apply in the app instead of its defaults.
ai_connection_explain: Bring your own key: your assistant and your agents then spend your tokens, not the organization's.
ai_connection_model_hint: Its identifier at the provider, for instance gpt-6.1-sol.
ai_connection_key_hint: Tried once at the provider, kept encrypted, never shown again.
ai_connection_none: No key connected: you use the organization's model.
ai_connection_unavailable: This instance keeps no secret yet: ask its operator to set its encryption key.
ai_policy_allowed: Anyone may bring a key; otherwise, the organization pays
ai_policy_required: Everyone uses their own key; the organization pays for no one
ai_policy_off: The organization pays for everyone; no personal key
ai_policy_allowed_person: You may bring your own key. Without it, you use the organization's model.
ai_policy_required_person: Your organization asks everyone to use their own key: without it, your assistant does not answer.
ai_policy_off_person: Your organization pays for everyone's models: no personal key.
error_provider_unreachable: The provider does not answer: try again later.
error_personal_off: Your organization does not allow personal keys.
chat_mentions: Mention a person or an app
chat_attach: Attach a file (PDF, Word, text, image)
cmd_summarize_body: The conversation and the files in a few points
cmd_write_body: A document in the canvas: letter, note, report
cmd_explain_body: As to someone new to the subject
cmd_actions_body: With owner and deadline, as drafts to validate
chat_hint: @ to mention, / for a command, drop a file. {model}
error_unsupported_file: This kind of file is not read: PDF, Word, text, CSV or image.
error_unreadable_file: This file could not be read.
ai_subscription_explain: Use the ChatGPT subscription you already pay for. It signs in on a machine of your own, never on Kete's servers, and answers from what you give it, without Kete Enterprise's tools.
ai_subscription_step: Open the sign-in page, sign in to your account, then enter this code (valid 15 minutes):
ai_subscription_signing_in: Signing in: finish on the sign-in page, then click « I'm done ».
ai_subscription_waiting: Not signed in yet: finish on the sign-in page, then try again.
ai_subscription_unavailable: This instance does not offer subscriptions yet: ask its operator.
error_payer_refused: Your organization does not allow this way to pay.
error_subscription_lost: Your subscription no longer answers: connect it again in « My AI connection ».
schedules_explain: Your morning briefing, or a question your assistant answers at a set time, with your rights. The answer lands in « To do », and by e-mail if you wish.
schedules_none: No scheduled task. You can also ask the assistant: « every Monday at 8, my team's late actions ».
schedules_prompt_hint: For example: which actions of my team are late?
schedules_ran: Done: the answer is in « To do ».
schedules_ran_briefing: Done: your briefing is on your home page.
error_too_many_schedules: You already have twenty scheduled tasks: remove one first.
